News Our Team Faqs Library Map Facilities Specialized Libraries Venue and Study Spaces Seminar Hall Meeting Rooms Silent Area (Quiet Zone) Networking and Outreach Archive Unit Borrowing and Circulation Library Sections E-Resources Research Softwares UoD Newsletter UoD Repository AI Research Hub UoD Journals UoD Catalog System MOOCs For Education Training Research Assistance Sessions Orientation and Tutoring Program Contact us English English Arabic Kurdish Central Library celebrates rename "Honoring the Legacy of Dr. Asmat Mohammad Khalid" Welcome to the Central Library of the University of Duhok The central library is one of the most important knowledge hubs within the university. Explore! The library is designed to serve students, academic staff, researchers, and visitors by offering an inclusive and supportive space where knowledge can be accessed, explored, and shared. Donate The Central Library appreciates the support of individuals, institutions, and organizations that contribute to enriching the library’s academic resources. Donations play an important role in strengthening educational and research opportunities for students and academic staff. Donate! Library Opening Hours The Central Library is open during official working days to serve students and academic staff. Working Days: Sunday – Thursday Opening Time: 8:30 AM – 7:30 PM Closed: Friday and Saturday The library may extend its opening hours during examination periods and important academic seasons. Any changes to the schedule will be officially announced through the library website and university communication channels. Users are encouraged to visit the library during opening hours and follow the library regulations to ensure a productive environment for all. Contact Infomation Central Library – University of Duhok Address: University of Duhok, Main Campus, Duhok, Kurdistan Region, Iraq Email: [email protected] Phone: +964 750 907 8499 The Central Library welcomes inquiries, suggestions, and communication from students, staff, researchers, and visitors. We value every thoughtful question and every constructive idea that helps us grow stronger as a center of knowledge. Whether you seek guidance, wish to collaborate, or simply share feedback, our doors remain open in the spirit of learning and community. About the Library The Central Library at the University of Duhok is the main library that serves all colleges, departments, and research centers within the university. It provides a comprehensive collection of academic and educational materials that support undergraduate and postgraduate study, academic teaching, and scientific research. The library contains a diverse range of printed collections, including textbooks, reference books, academic publications, journals, newspapers, and research reports. In addition, it maintains a valuable archive of theses and dissertations produced by university students, which contribute significantly to academic development and research progress.
